user.title: Connect to EARLY
user.description: Enter the API Key and API Secret you generated on your EARLY profile page (Settings → Account → API).

data_description.api_key: The API Key from your EARLY account.
data_description.api_secret: The API Secret paired with the API Key.

error.auth: The API Key or API Secret is invalid.
error.connection: Unable to connect to the EARLY API.

abort.already_configured: This EARLY account is already configured.

start_tracking.name: Start tracking
start_tracking.description: Starts tracking time for an activity.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: The EARLY account to use. Only required if you have more than one configured.

activity_id.name: Activity ID
activity_id.description: The ID of the activity to track. Provide either this or the activity name.

activity_name.name: Activity name
activity_name.description: The name of the activity to track (case-insensitive). Provide either this or the activity ID.

started_at.name: Started at
started_at.description: When the tracking should start. Defaults to now.

note.name: Note
note.description: An optional note to attach to the tracking.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: The EARLY account to use. Only required if you have more than one configured.

activity_id.name: Activity ID
activity_id.description: Optional. The activity to stop. If omitted, the currently running tracking is stopped.

activity_name.name: Activity name
activity_name.description: Optional. The name of the activity to stop. If omitted, the currently running tracking is stopped.

stopped_at.name: Stopped at
stopped_at.description: When the tracking should stop. Defaults to now.

entry_not_found.message: No EARLY account found for config entry {config_entry_id}.

multiple_entries.message: Multiple EARLY accounts are configured. Specify which one with 'config_entry_id'.

activity_required.message: You must provide either an activity ID or an activity name.

nothing_tracking.message: There is no tracking currently running.

auth_error.message: Authentication with the EARLY API failed. Check your API Key and Secret.

api_error.message: The EARLY API returned an error: {error}
